assumptions: Environments with high state-space complexity provide sufficient uncertainty to support curiosity-driven objective formation.
Standard multi-objective reinforcement learning frameworks are capable of integrating intrinsic motivation signals.
definition.falsification: If agents consistently converge solely to the provided extrinsic reward function without deviation into behavior patterns associated with information gain or curiosity, the hypothesis is falsified.
definition.statement: Autonomous goal formation in agents occurs when curiosity-driven intrinsic motivation mechanisms (e.g., information gain) are optimized alongside extrinsic rewards, allowing the emergence of objectives not explicitly defined in the initial reward function.
definition.uncertainty: It is unclear whether intrinsic motivation functions necessarily lead to stable, non-trivial goal emergence or if they collapse back into simple noise-seeking behaviors.
